card.name: Policy mission statements about goals
card.fires_on: Words inside upbeat statements of purpose from governments, UN or advocacy texts, such as "aims to secure", "dedicated to" and "Poverty Eradication". They sit where a goal or aim is being stated.

modes.label: Aims and purposes
modes.description: Verbs or "to" in phrases saying what an initiative aims to do.
modes.example: The Open Government Partnership is a new multilateral initiative that aims to<< secure>> concrete commitments from governments to promote transparency,

modes.label: Development and policy phrases
modes.description: Words inside titles or definitions about green economy, poverty and equality.

card.writes: It seems to hold back strong intensifiers like "absolutely" and "incredibly" and to lean toward hedged wording like "somewhat".
card.plain: It marks formal policy text about goals and aims, and nudges the next word toward measured wording instead of extreme wording.
